_note: Rule parameters for token value validation. Shared by the client store and the token server so the two cannot disagree. The logic lives in code on each side — this file holds ranges and patterns only, never functions. Lives under mobile/src/ because there is no metro.config.js, so Metro cannot resolve a file outside the app root.

color.patternNote: 3, 4, 6 and 8 digit hex. The panel writes 6-digit from <input type=color>, but the file is hand-editable, so 3-digit shorthand (#fff) and alpha forms are legal. rgb() is refused: no component in this app parses it, so accepting it would write a value that renders as garbage.

notes.radius: ceiling is 999 so radius.pill is accepted rather than rejected by accident — it is the only reason pill exists.
notes.space: generous ceiling; space.xl is 52 and the scale is not the thing being policed.
notes.typeSize: 1..400 covers any legible scale while still rejecting 0, which renders nothing.
notes.typeLineHeight: 0 allowed — an author may want a deliberately tight single line. Negative is not.
notes.typeLetterSpacing: signed on purpose; the real scale uses -0.5 and 0.2.

fontWeight.patternNote: A string, not a number: tokens.json holds "800", and type.*.weight was briefly mis-typed as numeric in the brief. Multiples of 100 from 100 to 900.

boxShadow.note: Validated in code against a real box-shadow shape by validateBoxShadow in tokenValidation.ts. Parameters here because the ceiling and the layer count are policy rather than parsing.
